title: Manager / Sr. Executive – Affiliate & Brand Alliances (Beauty / D2C)
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an owner who can scale affiliate, cashback, coupon and fintech/super-app partnerships into a core revenue channel. The goal is low-CAC incremental sales and new-customer acquisition across our D2C website and marketplace.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Affiliate Programs
* Build and scale the in-house D2C affiliate program on Shopify Plus, covering partner onboarding, tracking links, payouts and fraud control.
* Manage third-party affiliate networks and portals (Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission, Impact, etc.) and continuously add new publishers.
* Onboard influencers, creators, content/review sites and deal communities as affiliate partners.
* Cashback & Coupon Ecosystem
* Build partnerships and run campaigns with cashback portals (CashKaro, GoPaisa, etc.) and coupon portals (GrabOn, CouponDunia, etc.).
* Own the brand-wise coupon strategy: code structure, discount depth, exclusivity, leakage control, and monitoring of coupon abuse and brand-bidding.
* Super-App & Rewards Partnerships
* Launch offers, coupons, rewards and co-branded campaigns on platforms such as PhonePe, Paytm, Google Pay and Zomato.
* Explore new platforms and bank, fintech and loyalty partnerships that bring in high-intent customers.
* Planning & Campaigns
* Create a partner-wise campaign calendar for launches, festive sales (Diwali, BFCM, EOSS) and key SKUs.
* Negotiate commission structures: CPS/CPA, tiered, performance-linked and exclusive deals.
* Tracking, Analytics & Reporting
* Track clicks, orders, AOV, new vs. repeat customers, CAC, ROAS, commission payouts and incrementality.
* Ensure accurate attribution (UTM, coupon-level, network-level) and catch fake or duplicate conversions.
* Build weekly/monthly dashboards and partner scorecards; pause low performers and scale winners.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Work with Brand, Performance Marketing, E-commerce, Creative, Finance and Tech teams on offers, creatives, tracking setup and payout reconciliation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce or a related field (MBA/PGDM preferred).
* 3–6 years of experience in affiliate, partnerships, performance or e-commerce marketing. Beauty, D2C or FMCG background preferred.
* Hands-on experience with affiliate networks/platforms (Impact, Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission) and cashback/coupon portals.
* Strong understanding of coupon-led and offer-led growth (CPS/CPA, margin math, abuse control).
* Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-management skills.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; working knowledge of GA4 and Shopify analytics.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with super-app/fintech offer platforms (PhonePe, Paytm, GPay, Zomato) or bank/credit-card reward partnerships.
* Understanding of marketplace affiliate programs (Amazon, Nykaa).

Success Metrics (first 6–12 months)
  
  

* Share of revenue and new-customer count from the affiliate/partnership channel.
* Blended CAC and ROAS within target.
* Number of active partners and top-partner concentration.
* Minimal coupon leakage and invalid payouts.

title: Senior Engineer - MDM
description:

The MDM Engineer will regularly collaborate with customers, peers, vendors and leadership through phone, email, chat, video conferencing and ticketing systems such as ServiceNow to ensure timely and effective issue resolution.

* Monitor and manage enrolled mobile devices across iOS, Android and Windows platforms using the NinjaOne MDM platform.
* Troubleshoot mobile device enrollment, connectivity, policy compliance and application delivery issues using NinjaOne and remote support tools.
* Manage incidents, requests and changes through ServiceNow while documenting troubleshooting activities and customer communications.
* Take ownership of assigned tickets and drive issues through to resolution or appropriate escalation.
* Administer device configuration profiles, security policies and compliance baselines within NinjaOne to enforce organizational standards across managed endpoints.
* Manage application deployment, updates and removal across mobile device fleets using NinjaOne software management capabilities.
* Support device lifecycle activities including enrollment, onboarding, offboarding and remote wipe for lost or decommissioned devices.
* Communicate effectively with customers, peers, management and cross functional engineering teams regarding incidents, outages and change activities.
* Participate in an on call rotation to provide emergency support coverage when required.
* Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate with NinjaOne support or third party vendors as necessary.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, operational procedures and knowledge base articles.
* Recommend process improvements and identify operational risks or areas of concern to management.
* Continue developing technical expertise across additional MDM and endpoint management technologies as business needs evolve.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work and/or military experience.
* 2+ years of experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC), Managed Services or IT Operations environment.
* 2+ years of hands on experience administering or supporting a Mobile Device Management platform in a production environment.
* Hands on experience with NinjaOne MDM including device enrollment, policy configuration, software deployment and compliance monitoring.
* Experience managing iOS, Android and Windows mobile devices including enrollment via Apple Business Manager, Android Enterprise or Windows Autopilot.
* Knowledge of MDM concepts including device configuration profiles, compliance policies, conditional access and remote device actions such as lock, wipe and retire.
* Understanding of mobile security concepts including device encryption, certificate based authentication, passcode enforcement and data loss prevention policies.
* Familiarity with identity and access management concepts as they relate to MDM including Azure Active Directory or Entra ID integration and single sign on.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose device enrollment, policy and connectivity issues across multiple platforms.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non technical audiences.
* Strong customer service and relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast paced operations environment.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in SLA driven support environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL based incident, problem and change management processes.
* Experience using ServiceNow or similar ticketing platforms.
* Experience with additional MDM platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf or VMware Workspace ONE.
* Familiarity with NinjaOne RMM capabilities including scripting, automation and alerting as they complement MDM operations.
* Experience with PowerShell or scripting tools for automating device management tasks and reporting.
* Relevant certifications such as NinjaOne certifications, CompTIA Mobile App Security or equivalent vendor credentials.

#### **Core Competencies**

* Accountability and ownership
* Adaptability and flexibility
* Analytical thinking and problem solving
* Attention to detail
* Customer focus
* Dependability and integrity
* Initiative and self direction
* Team collaboration
* Stress tolerance and professionalism under pressure

title: Support Engineer
description:
**About Signeasy**

**Contracts run businesses. We're unlocking the intelligence inside them.**

Signeasy began 16 years ago with a simple idea: signing should be easy. That idea helped the world go paperless. But signatures were only the beginning.

Today, the real problem isn't signing contracts. It's what happens after. In most companies, contracts sit scattered across inboxes, shared drives, CLMs, ERPs, and filing systems. They're static, forgotten, and underused, yet they quietly define revenue, risk, compliance, and growth. We believe contracts are one of the most powerful and most overlooked sources of truth in a business.

2025 changed everything. While others continued to treat contracts as paperwork, we began turning them into living, searchable, and intelligent systems of record. We shipped more than 250 product releases, achieved 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and were featured at Apple's WWDC, all while building the foundation for what comes next.

2026 is our biggest year yet. With the launch of Intelligent Contract Management, we're going to market with an AI-powered contract management platform built for modern teams who expect more than storage, signatures, or status quo software.

This is the moment, and this is the team building it. If you want to help shape the future of contracts with us, read on.

**Your role**

As our Support Engineer, you'll be part of the Customer Support team and the technical voice of Signeasy for our customers. You'll resolve the issues that need more than a help article: API errors, integration failures, SSO setups, mobile app, and tricky account problems. You'll handle tickets end to end and get on calls with our enterprise and API customers when a conversation works better than an email thread.

You'll be the bridge between customers and our engineering team. When something is broken, you'll reproduce it, find the root cause where you can, and hand engineering a clean, well-documented ticket. When something is confusing, you'll fix it at the source with better docs, macros, and product feedback.

If you enjoy digging into logs, love the moment a stubborn issue finally clicks, and care about leaving every customer better off than you found them, you'll find a lot to love here.

**What you'll do**

**Ticket resolution**

* Own tickets across email, chat, and phone, from first response to resolution, within our support SLAs
* Take escalations from the frontline team and resolve complex issues across our web app, iOS and Android apps, eSign API, and Intelligent Contract Management
* Troubleshoot integrations with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, HubSpot, Salesforce, and other tools our customers rely on
* Keep customers informed with clear, honest updates, and manage expectations on timelines and workarounds

**Enterprise and API customers**

* Join calls with enterprise and API customers to debug live issues, walk through setups, and answer technical questions
* Help developers integrate our eSign API: review their requests, read error responses, and point them to best practices
* Support admins with account configuration, SSO/SAML, user management, and compliance-related questions

**Debugging and escalation to engineering**

* Reproduce issues across platforms, and investigate using logs, HAR files, browser dev tools, API tools such as Postman, and SQL queries
* Separate configuration issues from real bugs, and file well-documented Jira tickets with steps to reproduce, impact, and customer context
* Follow escalations through to closure and close the loop with the customer

**Knowledge and product feedback**

* Write and update help center articles, internal runbooks, and Zendesk macros so the next customer or teammate solves it faster
* Spot recurring issues and trends, and share them with Product and Engineering to improve the product
* Respond to app store reviews that need a technical answer

**AI and automation**

* Use AI tools to investigate issues, draft responses, and summarize ticket trends
* Build simple scripts, automations, and templates that cut repetitive work for the support team

**Who you are**

We're looking for someone technical, curious, and customer-first: a problem solver who takes ownership and doesn't let an issue go cold.

* 3 to 4 years of experience in technical or product support for a B2B SaaS product
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, and JSON, with hands-on experience using Postman or similar tools
* Comfort reading logs, analyzing HAR files, and using browser developer tools
* Experience troubleshooting web and mobile apps
* Hands-on experience with Zendesk (or a similar helpdesk) and Jira
* Confidence leading customer calls, including with technical and enterprise stakeholders
* Strong written and spoken English, with a clear, empathetic, and crisp communication style
* Self-driven, organized, and calm under pressure, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with SSO/SAML, OAuth, and webhooks
* Exposure to integrations such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365
* Basic scripting in Python or JavaScript
* Experience with iOS or Android debugging tools

**Why you'll love this role**

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Proofpoint L3 Operations Engineer serves as the technical SME for the Proofpoint environment and is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, platform optimisation, configuration management, security enhancements, integrations, and engineering support. The role owns complex incidents, problem management, and platform improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Advanced Troubleshooting**

* Resolve complex email delivery and security incidents.
* Perform deep-dive analysis of:

+ Mail flow failures
+ TAP detections
+ DLP events
+ Email authentication failures
+ Encryption issues

* Analyse SMTP transactions, logs, headers, and threat intelligence data.

**Platform Engineering & Administration**

* Design and implement:

+ Security policies
+ DLP rules
+ TAP policies
+ Encryption policies
+ Threat detection tuning

* Configure:

+ SPF
+ DKIM
+ DMARC
+ Secure Email Relay
+ MX Routing

* Support tenant expansion and implementation initiatives.

**Security Enhancements**

* Optimise threat detection and false-positive reduction.
* Evaluate emerging email threats and protection strategies.
* Provide security recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.

**Integrations**

* Integrate Proofpoint with:

+ Microsoft 365
+ Exchange Online
+ SIEM platforms
+ Splunk
+ Sentinel
+ Threat Intelligence platforms

* Support API-based integrations and automation initiatives.

**Problem & Change Management**

* Lead root cause analysis activities.
* Own problem records and long-term remediation plans.
* Review and approve platform changes.
* Participate in CAB activities.

**Technical Leadership**

* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers.
* Develop operational runbooks and knowledge articles.
* Provide escalation support during major incidents.

**Required Skills**
**Proofpoint Expertise**

* Proofpoint Email Protection
* Proofpoint TAP
* Proofpoint Threat Response
* Proofpoint DLP
* Proofpoint Encryption
* Email Fraud Defence (Good to Have)

**Advanced Technical Skills**

* SMTP Protocol Analysis
* Exchange Online
* Microsoft 365 Security Stack
* Email Authentication Frameworks (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
* Secure Email Gateway Architecture
* DNS & MX Routing Design
* API Integrations
* PowerShell Scripting

**Security Knowledge**

* Phishing Protection
* Malware Analysis
* Threat Hunting
* Email Security Architecture
* Incident Response
* Data Loss Prevention

**Monitoring & Analytics**

* Splunk
* Microsoft Sentinel
* Defender for Office 365
* SIEM Correlation

**Experience**

* 6-10 years of Cybersecurity or Messaging Security experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on Proofpoint administration and engineering.
* Experience in enterprise-scale email security environments.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Proofpoint Certified Professional (PCP)
* Proofpoint Certified Guardian
* Microsoft Security Operations Analyst
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* ITIL Foundation

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Microsoft Defender for Office 365
* Mimecast
* Cisco Secure Email
* Exchange Hybrid
* Azure Automation
* Python/PowerShell Automation
* Security Operations Centre (SOC) experience

**EY Managed Services Expectations**

* Strong ITSM discipline (Incident, Problem, Change, Request Management)
* Queue ownership and SLA adherence
* 24x7 support participation
* Continuous service improvement mindset
* Excellent stakeholder communication and reporting skills

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

We are looking for an experienced **Corporate IT & Workplace Technology Manager** to own end-to-end IT operations for a growing technology organisation.

This is a hands-on, single-owner domain expert role responsible for corporate IT infrastructure, endpoint management, IT asset lifecycle, workplace technology, networking, identity and access management, and IT compliance. The ideal candidate will be comfortable independently managing the entire IT environment while building secure, reliable, and scalable systems for a growing workforce.

----------------

* Own end-to-end corporate IT operations for the organisation and Bengaluru office.
* Manage **MacBook, Windows devices, peripherals, and other IT hardware** across the complete asset lifecycle.
* Lead hardware procurement, reseller negotiations, AMC management, warranty coordination, buybacks, refresh cycles, and replacements.
* Implement and manage **zero-touch MDM and endpoint security** across macOS and Windows environments.
* Manage endpoint encryption, patching, EDR, security policies, compliance controls, and remote-wipe capabilities.
* Maintain accurate IT asset records from **procurement through disposal**, ensuring zero untracked devices.
* Manage ITAM/ITSM platforms and maintain accurate asset, service, and support documentation.

* Maintain SaaS application inventory, ownership, licensing, renewals, and technology spend.
* Support **SOC 2 and ISO 27001** compliance requirements, including endpoint evidence, access reviews, policies, and audit documentation.
* Ensure backups are configured, monitored, and periodically tested.
* Establish and maintain IT policies, processes, documentation, and operational standards.
* Coordinate with vendors, technology partners, security teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to improve IT reliability, security, automation, employee experience, and operational efficiency.
* Monitor technology costs and identify opportunities for vendor and SaaS optimisation.
* Troubleshoot critical infrastructure, endpoint, networking, identity, and workplace technology issues.
* Ensure the IT environment remains secure, scalable, compliant, and aligned with business requirements.

* **6–11 years of experience** in corporate IT, IT operations, workplace technology, or a related field.

* Strong hands-on experience managing corporate IT environments in a product company or technology startup.

* Experience administering ITAM or ITSM platforms such as **Snipe-IT, Freshservice, Jira Service Management, or ServiceNow**.
* Hands-on experience with conference-room and workplace AV solutions such as **Zoom Rooms, Google Meet hardware, Neat, Poly, Logitech, or Crestron**.
* Strong understanding of endpoint security, device encryption, patch management, EDR, remote management, and security controls.
* Experience managing **Google Workspace, SSO, SAML, identity lifecycle, and access reviews**.
* Working knowledge of **SOC 2, ISO 27001**, audit evidence, IT controls, and compliance requirements.
* Strong vendor management, procurement, negotiation, and IT budget-management skills.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently as the primary IT owner.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced **product/startup environment** rather than a traditional IT services or pure GCC support setup.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, security, and operational reliability.
* Willingness to work **on-site in Bengaluru** and take complete ownership of the corporate IT environment.

Job Title: Service Desk Operations & Governance SME  
Position: Associate Consultant
  
Experience: 6+ Years  
Category: Software Development/ Engineering  
Main location: Bangalore  
Job Code: J0826-2154  
Employment Type: Full Time  
  
Job Description:
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Service Desk professional with strong operational and ITIL expertise to take ownership of the day-to-day operational governance of a multilingual Service Desk environment.  
The role will be responsible for ensuring that Service Desk operations are structured, measurable, governed and continuously improved. The individual will analyse operational performance, identify recurring issues and service gaps, drive corrective actions, ensure adherence to agreed processes and coordinate with L2/L3 teams to improve resolution outcomes.  
The role is not limited to managing people or monitoring queues. The successful candidate will act as a Service Desk subject-matter expert and operational governance owner, bringing structure, discipline and analytical insight into the operation.  
The role will work closely with the Service Delivery Manager, Service Desk Leads, L2/L3 resolver teams, application teams, infrastructure teams, workplace/EUS teams, vendors and client stakeholders.  
Key Responsibilities:  
  
1. Service Desk Operational Governance  

* Own the day-to-day operational governance of the Service Desk.
* Establish and maintain operational routines covering:

o Daily operational review  
o SLA performance  
o Backlog  
o Aging tickets  
o Priority incidents  
o Reassignments  
o Escalations  
o Abandoned/unanswered calls  
o Ticket quality  
o Customer feedback  

* Ensure operational teams follow agreed processes, SOPs and ITIL practices.
* Identify deviations from the operating model and drive corrective actions.
* Ensure appropriate ownership and accountability across the Service Desk.
* Maintain operational readiness for changes, new services and project transitions.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
2. Performance & Data Analysis  
This should be one of the core responsibilities of the role.  

* Analyse Service Desk performance trends and identify underlying causes.
* Monitor and interpret:

o SLA achievement  
o Response and resolution performance  
o Ticket volumes  
o Backlog  
o Aging  
o Reopen rates  
o First Contact Resolution  
o Escalation rates  
o Call abandonment  
o Customer satisfaction  
o Productivity  
o Quality scores  

* Identify trends rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Produce meaningful operational insights and recommendations.
* Identify recurring operational issues and translate them into improvement initiatives.
* Maintain dashboards and management reports.
* Prepare inputs for weekly/monthly service reviews.
* Highlight risks and emerging issues to the SDM before they become escalations.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
3. Ticket Hygiene & Quality Management  

* Drive improvement in Service Desk ticket quality and documentation.
* Ensure tickets contain appropriate:

o Categorisation  
o Prioritisation  
o User/business impact  
o Troubleshooting performed  
o Worklogs  
o Resolution details  
o Knowledge references  
o Closure information  

* Perform regular ticket sampling and quality audits.
* Identify recurring quality issues by agent/team/process.
* Work with Team Leads to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure tickets are progressed appropriately and do not remain unnecessarily in queues.
* Identify tickets requiring escalation and ensure timely handover to L2/L3.
* Monitor tickets approaching SLA breach and ensure proactive intervention.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
4. Incident, Problem & Escalation Management  

* Provide operational oversight of Major/P1/P2 incidents from the Service Desk perspective.
* Ensure correct prioritisation and escalation based on business impact.
* Support Major Incident Management and ensure appropriate Service Desk participation.
* Identify recurring incidents and candidates for Problem Management.
* Analyse repeat incidents and identify opportunities for permanent resolution.
* Work with L2/L3 resolver groups to drive recurring-problem reduction.
* Track outstanding actions from major incidents and problem investigations.
* Ensure lessons learned are converted into process, knowledge or technical improvements.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
5. Cross-Functional Coordination  
Act as the operational bridge between Service Desk and resolver teams.  

* Coordinate with L2/L3 Infrastructure, Applications, EUS, IAM, Network, Cloud and other support teams.
* Identify bottlenecks in the incident/request resolution lifecycle.
* Challenge unnecessary ticket transfers and ownership gaps.
* Ensure clear escalation paths are followed.
* Drive resolution of aged or stuck tickets across resolver groups.
* Identify recurring dependency issues between Service Desk and other support towers.
* Work with application and infrastructure SMEs to improve knowledge available to the Service Desk.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
6. Process & Continual Service Improvement  

* Identify opportunities to streamline Service Desk processes.
* Review existing workflows and identify unnecessary manual steps.
* Drive continual improvement initiatives around:

o Incident management  
o Request fulfilment  
o Knowledge management  
o Escalation  
o Ticket routing  
o Categorisation  
o Automation  
o Self-service  
o Monitoring integration  

* Identify opportunities for automation and shift-left.
* Improve First Contact Resolution through better knowledge, tooling and training.
* Maintain and improve Service Desk SOPs and operational documentation.
* Support implementation of ITIL-aligned practices.
* Ensure improvements are measurable and demonstrate operational/business benefit.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
7. Knowledge Management  

* Ensure knowledge articles are available and usable by Service Desk agents.
* Identify knowledge gaps from ticket trends and recurring incidents.
* Work with L2/L3 teams to convert technical resolutions into Service Desk knowledge.
* Review the quality and usefulness of existing knowledge articles.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge Management and shift-left practices.
* Identify opportunities for self-service and automation based on recurring requests.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
8. Team Coaching & Operational Enablement  
The role should not replace the Team Leads, but should provide SME-level direction and coaching.  

* Coach Team Leads and senior analysts on ITIL processes and operational practices.
* Support agents in improving troubleshooting and ticket-handling quality.
* Identify capability gaps based on operational data.
* Recommend targeted training and coaching.
* Conduct periodic knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Support onboarding of new Service Desk resources.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
9. Client & Stakeholder Support  
The person will have stakeholder interaction, but the SDM remains the primary client/account owner.  

* Provide operational inputs for client service reviews.
* Prepare factual analysis and recommendations for the SDM.
* Participate in operational governance meetings.
* Support service-related escalations.
* Provide timely updates on operational risks and improvement actions.
* Translate operational data into meaningful business-level insights.
* Support the SDM in preparing service improvement proposals and operational roadmaps.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
10. Governance & Compliance  

* Ensure adherence to agreed governance frameworks and contractual processes.
* Maintain operational evidence required for audits and governance reviews.
* Ensure compliance with ITIL, security and organisational processes.
* Track actions, risks, issues and improvement initiatives.
* Maintain Service Desk operational documentation and control mechanisms.
* Support internal and client audits where required.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
11. Key Deliverables / KPIs  
I would make the role accountable for outcomes, rather than just activities.  
Area Expected Outcome  
SLA Consistent SLA achievement and early intervention on breaches  
Backlog Controlled and continuously improving backlog  
Ticket Aging Reduction of aged/stagnant tickets  
Ticket Quality Improved ticket hygiene and documentation  
FCR Continuous improvement in First Contact Resolution  
CSAT Improvement in customer experience  
Escalations Reduction in avoidable escalations  
Repeat Incidents Identification and reduction of recurring issues  
Quality Consistent quality audit performance  
Process Compliance High adherence to agreed ITIL processes  
Knowledge Increased usage and quality of knowledge articles  
Automation Identification and delivery of automation opportunities  
Continual Improvement Measurable improvement initiatives delivered  
Governance Accurate and timely operational reporting  
  
Mandatory Skills:  

* 6+ years of Service Desk / IT Operations experience, with significant experience in senior/SME/leadership roles.
* Strong experience managing large or complex Service Desk operations.
* Strong understanding of ITIL Incident, Request, Problem, Change and Knowledge Management.
* Experience with SLA/KPI management and operational governance.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Demonstrated experience in root-cause analysis and recurring-issue reduction.
* Strong understanding of Service Desk ticket lifecycle and ITSM practices.
* Experience working with L2/L3 resolver teams.
* Experience managing operational escalations.
* Experience in continual service improvement.
* Strong stakeholder communication skills.
* Experience working in a multi-team / multi-vendor IT environment.

Preferred Skills :
  

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* ITIL Managing Professional modules would be an advantage.
* Experience with TopDesk, ServiceNow, BMC Remedy or similar ITSM platforms.
* Experience with multilingual Service Desk operations.
* Experience with Service Desk transformation, automation and shift-left initiatives.
* Experience with Microsoft technologies / Workplace / EUS environments.
* Experience in outsourced IT service delivery / managed services

title: System Administrator
description:
Description
  

CTI has been a leading AV provider for over 35 years. Since we began in 1988, our mission has been simple: to provide a fantastic customer experience.

At CTI, our biggest asset is our people, and we know that sometimes the most awesome employees don’t fit the typical mold. If you are hardworking, friendly, and know the importance of fantastic customer service, you could be a good fit at CTI. We have developed a collaborative and lively working environment, where the best and the brightest show up to work each day ready to have fun and employ their passion for and knowledge of technology in everything they do. This creative atmosphere helps us apply and share our skills with our clients, who seek quality, high-end AV and Conference Solutions.

**So, what are we looking for?**

We are looking for a System Administrator in Pune whose attitude, skills, and work ethic will embody our mission “to provide a fantastic customer experience”. you’ll help maintain, support, and improve the systems and technology services that CTI employees rely on every day. You’ll also serve as an escalation resource for more complex technical issues and work closely with the Helpdesk, Networking, Cybersecurity, and other teams to keep our technology reliable, secure, and effective.

We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, documents their work, and enjoys solving problems. CTI employees are known as customer-focused problem-solvers who can get the job done and do it with a great attitude.

***What are your responsibilities?***

These responsibilities give an idea not a full picture of what you’ll do, as we work to embrace and capitalize on our employees’ strengths:

* **Systems Administration:** Maintain, monitor, troubleshoot, and support company systems, infrastructure, and business technology services.
* **Backend Systems Management:** Manage and maintain backend systems, servers, and related infrastructure to ensure system stability, availability, and performance.
* **User & Access Administration:** Manage user accounts, permissions, access, and related administrative requests while following established security practices.
* **Escalated Technical Support:** Serve as an escalation point for complex issues that require deeper troubleshooting beyond Level 1 support.
* **System Maintenance:** Assist with system updates, patching, upgrades, deployments, and ongoing lifecycle management.
* **Backup & Recovery Management:** Monitor and manage system and data backups, verify backup completion, troubleshoot backup failures, and assist with data restoration and recovery when needed.
* **Monitoring & Reliability:** Monitor system health, availability, and performance, and respond appropriately to issues to maintain reliable IT services.
* **Security Support:** Work with Cybersecurity and other IT team members to address vulnerabilities, access concerns, and security-related improvements.
* **Troubleshooting & Problem Solving:** Identify root causes, resolve recurring issues, and develop long-term solutions instead of relying solely on temporary fixes.
* **Projects & Improvements:** Participate in technology upgrades, migrations, deployments, and other IT projects.
* **Documentation:** Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles so information can be shared across the IT team.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with Helpdesk, Networking, Cybersecurity, vendors, and business teams to resolve issues and improve the employee technology experience.
* **Other Duties:** Perform other tasks as assigned.

***Will you fit in?***

* Our employees fearlessly embrace the company culture and applicants who merely want to punch in their timecards everyday are not what we are looking for.
* You can work independently with minimal guidance but aren’t afraid to ask the right questions when you need help.
* You are passionate about learning and sharing knowledge with your team to improve the entire team.
* You enjoy troubleshooting and finding better ways to solve recurring problems.
* Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical employees.
* Understand that great IT support is about both technology and customer experience.
* Are organized, dependable, and able to manage multiple priorities.
Are willing to jump in and help wherever needed to support the team.  

***Does experience count?***

* 3+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure support, or a similar IT role.
* Experience administering and supporting enterprise business systems, backend infrastructure, and user environments.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, applications, user access, endpoints, and network connectivity.
* Working knowledge of networking, identity and access management, system security, data backups, recovery procedures, and general infrastructure concepts.
* Experience supporting system updates, patching, maintenance, and technology deployments.
* Experience monitoring and managing system backups and assisting with data restoration and recovery when needed.
* Strong documentation and organizational skills.
* A strong customer service mindset with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and take ownership of issues through completion.
